source-integrity.sourceIndependence: Issuer Q2 results and filing support operating facts; current independent market sources are used only for valuation/trading context.

company-underwriting.operatingTrajectory: Q2 2026 revenue was $4.374B (+23.4% YoY), adjusted EBITDA $384M (+39.8%) with 8.8% margin, and 18-month backlog $21.391B (+30%); full-year guidance was raised. Negative $59M quarterly free cash flow tempers the momentum.
company-underwriting.balanceSheetAndCapital: Execution capacity is supported by growing earnings and backlog, while working-capital cash conversion and Superior acquisition financing/integration remain material constraints.
company-underwriting.governanceAndAllocation: Acquisition-led capability expansion is strategically coherent but raises integration and capital-allocation execution risk; evidence supports adequate-to-strong rather than exceptional governance.
company-underwriting.pricingAndConcentration: Scale, skilled labor and project execution support some economic capture, but construction remains competitively contestable and project mix/labor productivity constrain durable pricing power.

thesisQuality.basis: Record backlog, broad infrastructure demand and Superior capability support durable demand/value capture, tempered by contestable construction economics and execution risk.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue +23.4%, adjusted EBITDA +39.8%, margin expansion, backlog +30% and raised guidance support strong momentum; negative $59M quarterly FCF prevents a higher score.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current market data around $16.8B market cap, ~33.8x trailing P/E and ~19.5x forward P/E is not conventionally cheap but offers plausible growth-adjusted headroom after a large drawdown.

catalystScore.basis: Raised full-year guidance, record backlog conversion and Superior/data-center integration provide multiple identifiable near-term operating catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Management raised guidance amid strong execution, but Superior integration, purchase-price and financing risks keep governance/capital allocation below the upper strong band.

alignment2036.basis: Power delivery, communications, clean-energy and data-center electrical infrastructure directly serve durable grid, connectivity and compute needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Multiple infrastructure segments plus Superior reuse skilled execution capabilities across power, communications, energy and data-center markets.

bottleneckControl.basis: Scale, skilled labor, safety systems and customer relationships provide meaningful constraint participation, but services remain competitively contestable and project-specific.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Diversified infrastructure segments provide multiple demand paths, offset by shared sensitivity to capital budgets, rates, permitting and project timing.

substitutionResilience.basis: Execution scale and customer qualification create moderate replacement friction, but alternative contractors remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Scale provides procurement and labor-management capacity, but skilled labor, equipment/material availability and project logistics remain meaningful dependencies without evidence of exceptional redundancy.

pricingPower.basis: Margin expansion demonstrates some value capture, while competitive bidding, project mix and labor/input costs limit evidence for durable high pricing power.

riskEvidence.basis: Strong backlog and earnings coexist with negative quarterly FCF, acquisition integration, project execution, working-capital and infrastructure-cycle risks.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent issuer results and filing provide strong operating evidence and current independent market data supports valuation; exact data-center backlog contribution and post-close Superior economics remain unquantified.

scoreRecord.thesis: MasTec combines record infrastructure backlog, accelerating earnings and expanding power/data-center capability, with cash conversion and acquisition execution as the principal constraints.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Backlog growth may fail to convert into durable free cash flow if project mix, labor, working capital or Superior integration deteriorate.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 earnings and evidence of backlog conversion, cash-flow normalization and Superior integration.

unknowns: Exact data-center contribution within backlog remains unquantified.
Post-close Superior standalone margin and cash conversion are not yet observable.
